scenes.script:

Rahul says: Iske badle, Supernova AI par din mein bas 15 minutes spend karo.
Rahul says: Tumhari personal AI teacher, Miss Nova, tumhara level test karegi aur tumhare liye ek learning plan banayegi.
Rahul says: Yahan tum sirf padhte nahi ho, actually out loud bolte ho. Raat ke 2 baje practice karo, hazaar mistakes karo, woh tumhe kabhi judge nahi karegi.
Rahul says: Jab tum kahin phasoge, toh woh tumhe correct karegi aur Hindi mein logic explain karegi.
Rahul says: Time waste karna band karo. Aaj hi Supernova AI download karo aur bolna start karo.
